nodes.label: Auth authorization capability
nodes.meaning: Decide an exact permission for one trusted request and fail closed.

nodes.label: InboundAuthorizationRequest
nodes.meaning: Caller-supplied identity references only; it carries no permission, scope, role, revision, or decision authority.

nodes.label: TrustedInputSnapshot
nodes.meaning: The exact trusted authentication and route facts, identity joins, and source revisions used by one evaluation epoch.

nodes.label: TrustedAuthorizationCommand
nodes.meaning: A server-derived command whose permission and scope reference are copied from trusted route state.

nodes.label: AuthorizationStateSnapshot
nodes.meaning: Revision-closed active-role, grant, and scope-evidence state for the same evaluation epoch.

nodes.label: AuthorizationEvaluationEpoch
nodes.meaning: One transaction and one decision time bind all state read for one authorization decision.

nodes.label: AuthorizationDecision
nodes.meaning: The closed output set ALLOW or DENY.

nodes.label: FailClosedAuthorization
nodes.meaning: Any missing, duplicate, stale, mismatched, or uncertain prerequisite produces DENY.
